steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Kanboard at http://127.0.0.1:8085/ as admin/admin. Then open the project 'Bench Board' board and report the names of the board's columns in left-to-right order, exactly as shown. Do not modify any tasks.

02-create: On the Bench Board project (project_id=1), create a new task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' with a description containing the text '{{runid}}' and a due date of 2026-12-31, created directly in the '{{01-signin.work_in_progress_column_header}}' column if possible. Then report the task's numeric ID as shown (#<number>) and verify the description and due date on the task page. If you can't set everything at creation, edit the task afterwards so description includes '{{runid}}' and due date is 2026-12-31, and move it to the '{{01-signin.work_in_progress_column_header}}' column.

03-open: Open task {{02-create.task_reference}} ('{{runid}} Bench Task') in the Bench Board project and add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Progress note for {{runid}}'). Verify the comment appears on the task page and report its text. Do not change anything else.
